error_definition: (candidate - reference) / reference, signed; negative = under-estimation. stage_error is measured on the quantity named by 'stage'. local_total_error divides the difference of the changed quantity by the whole-life total (all 14 stages) and does not include stages that reuse the changed quantity. propagated_total_error is (SUM-03' - SUM-03) / SUM-03 where SUM-03' comes from re-running the reference calculation with the approximated input; propagation.stage_error holds the stage values of that run. A case whose reference is 0 has no relative error: it is counted in n_reference_zero, and in n_reference_zero_candidate_nonzero when the candidate is not 0.
target_definition: within_stage_target: the primary quantity and every real stage value measured for the candidate (by_stage, propagation.stage_error; worst_stage names the worst) have max |error| <= targets.stage and no case with reference 0 and candidate not 0. within_total_target: max |error| <= targets.total on propagated_total_error where it was measured, else on local_total_error (total_error_kind says which). Meeting a target on fictional data does not establish practical accuracy.
attachment_definition: scope / units / units_stage_level / evidence_scope: see bench/approx_meta.py. units are exactly the units measured on their own output (by_unit); units_stage_level are measured only through a stage total or a sum of units.
by_material_class_note: by_material_class は、資材の行に作用する候補について、1 シナリオ内の資材区分ごとの合計の誤差を集めたもの（設備は EQUIPMENT）。基準が 0 の（シナリオ, 区分）の組は相対誤差を作れないので集計から外し、その数と、そのうち候補が 0 でない数を by_material_class_zero_reference と区分ごとの n_reference_zero・n_reference_zero_candidate_nonzero に記録した。

bound.statement: 基準計算の回数は N = ceil(T·c0/c) − 1（c0 は 1 − 1e-9 に最も近い倍精度数）なので、T·c0/c − 1 ≤ N < T·c0/c が成り立つ。T/c − 1 ≤ N は、T/c が整数を相対 1e-9 以内で上回る周期では成り立たない（評価期間の終わりの相対 1e-9 以内の更新を数えないため）。上限 N ≤ T/c は常に成り立つ。
